lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from smaller, denser spots anteriorly to larger, more spaced blobs posteriorly along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse elevated intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible; one follows the dorsal-lateral transition and the second runs along the mid-flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a shadow-cast recession immediately below the ridge apex.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered toward the anterior and basal regions of the fin silhouette, with approximately six distinct nodes visible.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregularities and small nicks are present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. A prominent dark linear indentation runs horizontally along the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal remoras are visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface below the pectoral fin.
